items.title: Isaacman Doubles Down on New NASA Model for International Partnerships
items.summary: HOUSTON, TX — NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman is less than a year on the job, but he’s already upended the way the agency interacts with the rest of the world. But the agency is done “stitch[ing] together coalitions for the sake of coalitions,” Isaacman said at Payload’s Off World event in Houston on Wednesday.
